sentences.en: An important archaeological discovery on the island of Éfaté in the Pacific archipelago of Vanuatu has revealed traces of an ancient seafaring people, the distant ancestors of today's Polynesians.
sentences.zh: 瓦努阿图太平洋群岛埃法特岛的一项重要考古发现揭示了古代航海民族的踪迹,他们是当今波利尼西亚人的远祖。

sentences.en: An agricultural worker, digging in the grounds of a derelict plantation, scraped open a grave– the first of dozens in a burial ground some 3,000 years old.
sentences.zh: 一名农业工人在一个废弃种植园的土地上挖掘,挖出了一个坟墓——这是一个拥有约 3,000 年历史的墓地中的数十个坟墓中的第一个。

sentences.en: It is the oldest cemetery ever found in the Pacific islands, and it harbors the remains of an ancient people archaeologists call the Lapita.
sentences.zh: 这是太平洋岛屿上发现的最古老的墓地,里面埋藏着考古学家称为拉皮塔人的古代民族的遗骸。

sentences.en: They were daring blue-water adventurers who used basic canoes to rove across the ocean.

sentences.en: They were also pioneers who carried with them everything they would need to build new lives - their livestock, taro seedlings and stone tools.
sentences.zh: 他们也是先驱者,随身携带着建立新生活所需的一切——牲畜、芋苗和石器。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Within the span of several centuries, the Lapita stretched the boundaries of their world from the jungle-clad volcanoes of Papua New Guinea to the loneliest coral outliers of Tonga.
sentences.zh: 在几个世纪的时间里,拉皮塔人将他们的世界边界从巴布亚新几内亚丛林覆盖的火山延伸到汤加最孤独的珊瑚离群点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Lapita left precious few clues about themselves, but Éfaté expands the volume of data available to researchers dramatically.
sentences.zh: 拉皮塔人留下的关于他们自己的线索很少,但埃法特极大地扩大了研究人员可用的数据量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The remains of 62 individuals have been uncovered so far, and archaeologists were also thrilled to find six complete Lapita pots.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止,已经发现了 62 具遗骸,考古学家也很高兴发现了六个完整的拉皮塔陶罐。

sentences.en: Other items included a Lapita burial urn with modeled birds arranged on the rim as though peering down at the human remains sealed inside.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: 'It's an important discovery' says Matthew Spriggs, professor of archaeology at the Australian National University and head of the international team digging up the site, ‘for it conclusively identifies the remains as Lapita.’ DNA teased from these human remains may help answer one of the most puzzling questions in Pacific anthropology: did all Pacific islanders spring from one source or many?
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚国立大学考古学教授、该遗址挖掘国际团队负责人马修·斯普里格斯 (Matthew Spriggs) 说,“这是一项重要发现,因为它最终确定了这些遗骸是拉皮塔人。”从这些人类遗骸中提取的 DNA 可能有助于回答太平洋人类学中最令人费解的问题之一：所有太平洋岛民都是来自一个来源还是多个来源？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Was there only one outward migration from a single point in Asia, or several from different points?
sentences.zh: 亚洲的某一地点只有一次向外迁徙,还是从不同地点有多次向外迁徙？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘This represents the best opportunity we've had yet' says Spriggs, 'to find out who the Lapita actually were, where they came from, and who their closest descendants are today.’
sentences.zh: 斯普里格斯说,“这是我们迄今为止最好的机会,可以了解拉皮塔人到底是谁,他们来自哪里,以及他们今天最亲近的后裔是谁。”

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There is one stubborn question for which archaeology has yet to provide any answers: how did the Lapita accomplish the ancient equivalent of a moon landing, many times over?
sentences.zh: 有一个考古学尚未提供任何答案的顽固问题：拉皮塔人是如何多次完成相当于古代登月的任务的？

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: No-one has found one of their canoes or any rigging, which could reveal how the canoes were sailed.
sentences.zh: 没有人发现他们的独木舟或任何索具,这可以揭示独木舟是如何航行的。

sentences.en: Nor do the oral histories and traditions of later Polynesians offer any insights, for they turn into myths long before they reach as far back in time as the Lapita.
sentences.zh: 后来的波利尼西亚人的口述历史和传统也没有提供任何见解,因为它们早在拉皮塔人之前就已经变成了神话。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: 'All we can say for certain is that the Lapita find canoes that were capable of ocean voyages, and they had the ability to sail them,' says Geoff Irwin a professor of archaeology at the University of Auckland.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰大学考古学教授杰夫·欧文 (Geoff Irwin) 表示：“我们可以肯定地说,拉皮塔人发现了能够进行远洋航行的独木舟,并且他们有能力驾驶独木舟。”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Those sailing skills, he says, were developed and passed down over thousands of years by earlier mariners who worked their way through the archipelago of the western Pacific, making short crossings to nearby islands.
sentences.zh: 他说,这些航海技能是早期水手们在数千年的时间里发展和传承下来的,他们穿过西太平洋群岛,短途穿越到附近的岛屿。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The real adventure didn't begin, however, until their Lapita descendants sailed out of sight of land, with empty horizons on every side.
sentences.zh: 然而,真正的冒险并没有开始,直到他们的拉皮塔后裔驶出陆地的视线之外,四面都是空荡荡的地平线。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This must have been as difficult for them as landing on the moon for us today.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说肯定和我们今天登陆月球一样困难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Certainly, it distinguished them from their ancestors, but what gave them the courage to launch out on such risky voyages?
sentences.zh: 当然,这使他们有别于他们的祖先,但是什么让他们有勇气踏上如此危险的航行呢？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Lapita's thrust into the Pacific was eastward, against the prevailing trade winds, Irwin notes.
sentences.zh: 欧文指出,拉皮塔号逆着盛行的信风向东冲入太平洋。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Those nagging headwinds, he argues, may have been the key to their success.
sentences.zh: 他认为,那些挥之不去的逆风可能是他们成功的关键。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: "They could sail out for days into the unknown and assess the area, secure in the knowledge that if they didn’t find anything, they could turn about and catch a swift ride back on the trade winds.
sentences.zh: “他们可以航行数天进入未知世界并评估该地区,并确信如果他们没有发现任何东西,他们可以掉头并乘信风迅速返回。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Once out there, skilled seafarers would have detected abundant leads to follow to land: seabirds, coconuts and twigs carried out to sea by the tides, and the afternoon pileup of clouds on the horizon which often indicates an island in the distance.
sentences.zh: 一旦到达那里,熟练的海员就会发现大量的线索可以追踪到陆地：海鸟、椰子和树枝被潮汐带入大海,下午地平线上堆积的云彩通常表明远处有一座岛屿。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: For returning explorers, successful or not, the geography of their own archipelagos would have provided a safety net.

sentences.en: Vanuatu, for example, stretches more than 500 miles in a northwest-southeast trend, its scores of intervisible islands forming a backstop for mariners riding the trade winds home.
sentences.zh: 例如,瓦努阿图呈西北-东南走向绵延 500 多英里,其数十个可见的岛屿为乘着信风回家的水手提供了后盾。

sentences.en: All this presupposes one essential detail, says Atholl Anderson, professor of prehistory at the Australian National University: the Lapita had mastered the advanced art of sailing against the wind.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚国立大学史前史教授阿索尔·安德森说,所有这一切都以一个基本细节为前提：拉皮塔人掌握了逆风航行的先进艺术。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And there's no proof they could do any such thing; Anderson says.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: "There has been this assumption they did, and people have built canoes to re-create those early voyages based on that assumption.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: El Niño, the same climate disruption that affects the Pacific today, may have helped scatter the Lapita, Anderson suggests.

sentences.en: He points out that climate data obtained from slow-growing corals around the Pacific indicate a series of unusually frequent El Niños around the time of the Lapita expansion.

sentences.en: By winds for weeks at a time, these 'super El Niños' might have taken the Lapita on long unplanned voyages.

sentences.en: However they did it, the Lapita spread themselves a third of the way across the Pacific, then called it quits for reasons known only to them.

sentences.en: Ahead lay the vast emptiness of the central Pacific and perhaps they were too thinly stretched to venture farther.

sentences.en: They probably never numbered more than a few thousand in total, and in their rapid migration eastward they encountered hundreds of islandsmore than 300 in Fiji alone.
